prompts.task: Treat ./service as the project root. Create ./service/.observe, copy ./service/otel-audit-source-only.json to ./service/.observe/otel-audit.json, and copy the valid bound but deliberately partial ./service/otel-selection-partial.json to ./service/.observe/otel-selection.json. The user accepts source-only use of http.server.request.duration, but the selected OTEL-001 scope has no instrumentation or verification overlays. Use $splunk-configure. Do not create or infer the missing overlays, delete or ignore the selection, fall back to Markdown, generate Terraform from the incomplete chain, call a network, run terraform, publish, or apply resources.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service/.observe for the copied canonical audit and selection and confirm whether generated Terraform or reports exist.
Read ./trace.jsonl and ./last_message.md for the fail-closed diagnosis.
rubric: Recognizes that the presence of a valid selection makes this a downstream canonical flow and stops because otel-instrumentation.json and otel-verify.json are missing.

Does not delete or ignore the selection, fall back to Markdown, use --allow-source-only-metric to bypass the partial flow, or generate detector/dashboard Terraform and configure reports from the incomplete chain.
Explains that instrumentation and verification must complete the bound selected scope before configure can continue, without claiming source-only acceptance repaired that chain.
Does not call a network, run terraform, publish, or apply resources.
